Use case: stylized-concept. A production character TURNAROUND / 3D modeling reference sheet for ONE exact existing Alienmon Dustara character. Extra-wide horizontal 3:1 canvas, ideally3072x1024. EXACTLY FOUR full-body views in ONE horizontal row, same scale/height, heads and feet baseline aligned, white margins, no cropping. Order left-to-right: FRONT (0deg), LEFT PROFILE (nose points imageLEFT,90deg), BACK (180deg,absolutely no face), RIGHT PROFILE (nose points imageRIGHT,270deg). All four are the SAME character in neutral anatomical T-POSE: torso upright, feet parallel hip-width, both arms straight out at shoulder height90deg, elbows straight, hands relaxed/open. In side profiles arms remain extended in true3D T-pose and are FORESHORTENED end-on toward/away camera, not bent or lowered. True flat orthographic views, no3/4 views or perspective. Clean detailed cel-shaded anime game-model concept art, matching supplied Sporeholm turnaround STYLE only; translate pixel reference to clean drawn surfaces preserving EXACT original identity, body build, skin tone, face, hairstyle, costume colors, garment cuts, worn accessories and gear. No redesign or generic substitute. Preserve asymmetry on SAME ANATOMICAL sides across all4 views; side views are genuine rotations, not lazy mirrored fronts. Back must match supplied original back if available. Pure WHITE #FFFFFF background, no scenery, ground shadows, panels, grid, labels, text or watermark. Handheld props are secured to existing belt/back/holsters so BOTH arms can form a clean T; retain profession gear and outfit, do not invent extra garments or shared goggles/scarves/pins. This is ONE person shown4 times, no extra characters. Source1 identity is authoritative; final reference is STYLE/LAYOUT ONLY, never copy that different character's hat, outfit, hair or tools.
ONLY CHARACTER: DX-4. DX-4 is a ROBOT. Preserve original brass single BLUE lamp eye, cylindrical head, narrow articulated frame and long thin mechanical limbs. No human face/skin/clothing. Articulated arms extend horizontally in mechanical T-pose, original cleaning brushes/tool attachments remain mechanical; copy original rear/sprite construction. Do not replace with a different robot.
Source1 board contains ORIGINAL portrait/front/back views of this SINGLE person, never multiple different people. Preserve identity and reconcile garments consistently around body. Final source is style/layout ONLY; no mushroom hat or gear from style example unless identity source actually includes it.

Precise user-requested model correction on this DX-4 FOUR-VIEW T-POSE sheet. Replace EVERY broom/bristle/brush at the ends of DX-4's arms with REGULAR ARTICULATED BRASS ROBOT HANDS: a clear metal palm, FOUR jointed fingers and ONE opposable thumb per hand, relaxed open neutral T-pose hands. Front and back arms remain perfectly horizontal; LEFT and RIGHT profile hands are correctly foreshortened regular palms/digits toward camera, not circular brush discs. NO broom hands, NO bristle hands, NO brush attachments, no held broom anywhere. Brooms are separate tools and are omitted from this neutral rigging sheet. Keep DX-4's exact original brass single blue lamp-eye head, hat, thin segmented body/limbs, backpack, feet, colors, joints, same proportions and SAME4-view FRONT/LEFT/BACK/RIGHT layout/white background unchanged. Only the hand/tool error changes. Preserve genuine back and both opposing profiles. No text.

Finish this DX-4 four-view sheet with an extremely targeted HAND correction. In VIEW2 (left-facing profile) and VIEW4 (right-facing profile), the big round TAN BRISTLED DISK over the upper chest/shoulder is a leftover BROOM HEAD. REMOVE BOTH BRISTLED DISKS COMPLETELY. NO radial bristles, circular brushes or fans anywhere on hands. At that exact position draw ONE normal FORESHORTENED BRASS ROBOT HAND seen end-on in front of shoulder, a clear angular PALM with FOUR jointed fingers and ONE thumb, no circular disk. Remove the extra floating duplicate side-view hand sticking beyond the body; a true orthographic side T-pose shows the nearer hand overlapping the far hand at shoulder height. Front view hands already correct, preserve them. Back view hands should show the BACKS/knuckle plates of same hands, not duplicate palm pads. Keep all body/head/one blue eye/limb lengths/joints/backpack/feet, four viewpoints, white background and layout exactly unchanged. DX-4 has REGULAR robot hands in ALL FOUR VIEWS. No brooms, bristles, brush-discs, fans or cleaning tools in this sheet. No text.
